cases.name: Every generated package retains exact complete source rows, geometry references, metadata and global change years
All 5424 supported historical years have the same ordered active record set as the full catalog
Date windows cross BCE/CE without a year zero and clamp the published range
Concurrent and repeated dates within one window share the same request and exact object
Different years and the shared empty package remain independent and never request the full catalog
A failed fetch is evicted and a second request can succeed
Wrong date packages and malformed rows fail explicitly and evict the underlying JSON cache
Out-of-range data cannot smuggle records into an empty historical year
The full catalog and original archive stay byte-for-byte untouched by map loading

method: Actual generated files compared to canonical full lean catalog for all supported years; loader failure, malformed-response, concurrency and retry tests. This is data/loader validation, not browser timing.
